verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official MCP server that connects agents such as Codex, Cursor, Claude Code and ChatGPT to Statsig data, and admins can configure Claude's connection centrally. A separate, keyless Docs MCP server is also offered, and a probe confirms the official MCP server documentation exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, and detailed documentation of the exposed tools (for example, whether write actions are supported beyond querying and exploring data).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Statsig MCP (Model Context Protocol) server brings the power of Statsig into tools like Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code. With this setup, you can ask questions, explore experiments, and access your Statsig data using AI.
Admins can configure Claude's connection to Statsig centrally instead of asking each member to authenticate.
Use the Statsig Docs MCP server to let supported AI clients read public Statsig documentation directly from /api/mcp.
